description: Hi! I'm passionate about tackling the "Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data" challenge to support farmers against climate change using satellite and environmental data. I am looking for enthusiastic teammates skilled in coding, data analysis, UI/UX design, or agriculture to build a practical, impactful smart-farming solution together. If you're eager to innovate and make a real-world difference in food security, let's team up and bring this project to life
summary: Using NASA satellite data weather feedback, and AI that will give farmers the chance to know their land and to make the right decision for their plants and plan to have their farming industries earn profit. We reduce farming risks and save resources with sustainable agriculture.
details: The project is a website that helps farmers make better decisions with data from NASA. The farmer selects a land on the map and the website evaluates its temperature, rainfall, soil moisture, and solar radiation by using NASA POWER, GEOS-FP, and GPM data. It then recommends suitable crops, estimates the planting and harvesting times, tracks crop growth with Growing Degree Days and provides a five-day weather forecast with risk warnings. The website also compares crop rotations, tests scenarios such as less rainfall and calculates irrigation needs and costs in ILS or USD. The Gemini-driven Farm Assistant explains results in simple language and clearly separates actuals from estimates and assumptions.
